text:
anja: Follow-up from the 3/14 postmortem. Recurring pattern: handshake timeouts -> truncated streams -> reconnect storms. Need owners and dates for fixes.

mike: I'll own server handshake hardening. Plan: add p95/p99 accept-queue metrics, increase handshake timeout behind flag. ETA Tue.

yara: I'll own client SDK backoff + max-conns. Will add exponential backoff with capped jitter and beta tags for node/python. ETA Wed.

mike: Hypothesis: accept queue saturation during reconnect spikes. Action: capture SO_ACCEPT_QUEUE and per-worker socket counts. Small reproducer coming.

anja: Need detection: emit stream.partial sentinel when stream ends without EOS. Yara, make SDK expose handler for it.

yara: Will add 'partial_response' event and example retry snippet. Will respect idempotency header before retry.

eng-infra: We can provision a 3-shard harness in staging. Please file INF ticket with QPS and duration.

anja: Canary window: 01:00-05:00 UTC Thurs. Rollback if partial_rate > 2x baseline or error rate +0.5%.

mike: I'll add Grafana panels and alerts for stream.accept.queue and stream.partial_rate.

yara: SDK beta release notes and example snippet will be posted here when ready.

ci-bot: Canary job scheduled -> 3278905000 targeting staging-1..3 :rocket:

anja: I'll draft a short runbook "triage partial responses" for oncall. Weekly follow-ups Fridays 09:00 PT until closed.

mike: ack.

yara: ack.

eng-infra: ack - created INF-4891 for harness quota.

anja: Thanks — ping in thread if blocked. :thumbsup:
